scope: Route the existing guest Desktop Settings remaining UI case through hosted acceptance without changing the native driver or inventory.
prior_behavior: The native driver reads MATRX_DESKTOP_SETTINGS_CASE with a full default; hosted acceptance passed artifact identity and guest mode but omitted that case variable.

selected_invocation.artifact_inputs: development_run_id and development_artifact_id from one successful CI main-push run
selected_invocation.credential: guest; no member or admin credential

routing: Workflow admission accepts only full or remaining; remaining requires desktop-settings-guest. The hosted wrapper repeats this check in preflight and passes MATRX_DESKTOP_SETTINGS_CASE to the existing native driver alongside the importer-selected directory, receipt, source SHA, run ID, artifact ID, and guest role. Hosted output logs the selected case; the driver report also records case and role.
verification: pnpm exec biome check scripts/hosted-desktop-settings-route.mjs scripts/hosted-desktop-settings-route.test.mjs scripts/hosted-guest-acceptance.mjs
remaining: No hosted native run, build, release, or inventory mutation in this routing lane. EXT-F-1003 T43 pairingForget and T49 ResetCancel remain unverified until the selected hosted run's real UI receipt is reviewed.
